items.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.

items.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
items.lead_paragraph: Daybreak Red brings GPT-5.6 Cyber to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock for authorized cybersecurity work.

items.title: A thousand fewer paths to root
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that found, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.

items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI is preparing its next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to test and strengthen its defenses using AI.

items.title: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI is raising Security Bug Bounty rewards and introducing report quality, loyalty, and priority campaign bonuses for independent security researchers.

items.title: LifeVal
items.lead_paragraph: Introducing LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.

items.title: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll to advise on responsible AI for national security modernization, cyber resilience, and collaboration with U.S. allies.

items.title: Qodo builds context into AI code review with Codex

items.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.

items.title: Fair use benefits everyone
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI shares excerpts from court briefs by creators, academics, accessibility advocates, and legal experts, among others, on how fair use supports AI training and innovation.

items.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

items.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

items.title: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
